summary: The note describes how three new small businesses on High Street in Greenfield (Bloom Café, Vintage Visions Boutique, TechSavvy Repair Shop) opened after September 1, 2023 and are strengthening the local economy. It covers job creation, the share of spending that stays local, sustainable practices, personalized service, effects on real estate, the involvement of retirees, and the use of technology. It closes with Small Business Saturday on November 25.
one_line: Three new High Street small businesses in Greenfield in autumn 2023 are creating jobs, keeping money local and reviving the town's economy.
key_facts: Bloom Café, Vintage Visions Boutique and TechSavvy Repair Shop opened on Greenfield's High Street after September 1, 2023.
Bloom Café held its ribbon-cutting ceremony on September 5; owner Mary Elizabeth called it a community space for local artisans and conversations.
The Greenfield Chamber of Commerce reports that since October 2023 new small business ventures have created over 150 jobs.
By September 25, TechSavvy Repair Shop had already hired 10 employees, and Bloom Café plans to hire a local baker and part-time baristas.

A report released in early November by the Greenfield Economic Development Committee found $0.68 of every dollar spent at local businesses stays in the community, versus $0.43 at non-local businesses.
Victoria Reagan launched Vintage Visions Boutique in mid-September and says consumers are seeking unique, local products with a personal touch.
Bloom Café sources organic produce from surrounding farms to minimize its carbon footprint.
TechSavvy Repair Shop offers online appointment booking and interactive troubleshooting guides; its manager is Megan Cho.
Real estate agent Tom Barkley observed a rise in inquiries for properties within walking distance of High Street after the new businesses opened.
Sarah Jennings, a retired school teacher, works part-time at Vintage Visions Boutique, illustrating the role of retirees in small business success.
High Street had faced challenges from e-commerce and large retail chains before the recent trend toward supporting local ventures.
Small Business Saturday takes place on the last Saturday of November, and Greenfield High Street will be decorated with banners and balloons on November 25.
